text: 港股文远知行今日上涨5.8%，带动文远知行(WRD.US)美股盘前再度上涨3%。消息面上，公司日前公布上半年总营收达3.46亿元，同比大幅增长73%。其中第二季度表现尤为亮眼，实现营收2.32亿元，同比增长82%，环比增长103%，显著超出市场预期。招商证券认为，公司二季度业绩表现亮眼，核心增长逻辑清晰；美银证券在文远知行绩后维持了“买入”评级，但目标价保持不变，为10.7美元。
text_en: WeRide's Hong Kong shares rose 5.8% today, also driving WeRide (WRD.US) U.S. pre-market shares up another 3%. On the news front, the company recently reported first-half total revenue of 346 million yuan, up 73% year-on-year. The second quarter was particularly strong, with revenue of 232 million yuan, up 82% year-on-year and 103% quarter-on-quarter, significantly beating market expectations. China Merchants Securities believes the company's Q2 performance was impressive with clear core growth logic; BofA Securities maintained a "Buy" rating on WeRide post-results, with the target price unchanged at $10.7.
